metadata.question: Did the snow water equivelent at Donner Pass higher in February than April in 2022?

<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use monthly TerraClimate SWE (IDAHO_EPSCOR/TERRACLIMATE) at Donner Pass (point: [-120.325, 39.317]) for Feb and Apr 2022. If empty, fallback to GLDAS NOAH 0.25deg 3-hourly (NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H) using monthly mean of SWE_inst.
2. Masking strategy: Not applicable (modeled grids). Use pixel counts to validate usable data.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: Zero SWE is valid; treat null/NaN or negative/implausible (>5000 mm) as C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.325, 39.317]); // Donner Pass, CA
    const geom = point.buffer(2000); // 2 km buffer
    const scale = 5000; // >=3000 as per guidance

    async function getMonthSWE(year, month) {
      const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, month, 1);
      const end = start.advance(1, 'month');

      // Try TerraClimate SWE (mm)
      const tcCol = ee.ImageCollection('IDAHO_EPSCOR/TERRACLIMATE')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select('swe');
      let tcSize = 0;
      try { tcSize = tcCol.size().getInfo(); } catch (e) { tcSize = 0; }

      if (tcSize > 0) {
        const img = ee.Image(tcCol.first()).select('swe').rename('swe');
        const valid = img.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('swe').getInfo();
        const total = ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('one').getInfo();
        if (!valid || valid === 0) return { status: 'C2', source: 'TerraClimate', imgs: tcSize, valid: valid || 0, total: total || 0 };
        const mean = img.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('swe').getInfo();
        if (mean === null || !isFinite(mean) || mean < 0 || mean > 5000) return { status: 'C3', source: 'TerraClimate', imgs: tcSize, valid, total };
        return { status: 'OK', source: 'TerraClimate', imgs: tcSize, valid, total, mean };
      }

      // Fallback: GLDAS NOAH v2.1 0.25deg 3-hourly SWE_inst (mm), monthly mean
      const gldasCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select('SWE_inst');
      let glSize = 0;
      try { glSize = gldasCol.size().getInfo(); } catch (e) { glSize = 0; }
      if (glSize === 0) return { status: 'C1', source: 'None', imgs: 0, valid: 0, total: 0 };

      const img = gldasCol.mean().rename('swe'); // mm
      const valid = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('swe').getInfo();
      const total = ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('one').getInfo();
      if (!valid || valid === 0) return { status: 'C2', source: 'GLDAS', imgs: glSize, valid: valid || 0, total: total || 0 };
      const mean = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('swe').getInfo();
      if (mean === null || !isFinite(mean) || mean < 0 || mean > 5000) return { status: 'C3', source: 'GLDAS', imgs: glSize, valid, total };
      return { status: 'OK', source: 'GLDAS', imgs: glSize, valid, total, mean };
    }

    // 2. Fetch months
    const feb = await getMonthSWE(2022, 2);
    const apr = await getMonthSWE(2022, 4);

    // 3. Print concise stats (<=20 lines)
    console.log(`Location: Donner Pass (~2 km buffer), Scale: ${scale} m`);
    console.log(`Feb 2022 -> Source: ${feb.source}, Imgs: ${feb.imgs}, Valid px: ${feb.valid}/${feb.total}, SWE(mm): ${feb.mean !== undefined ? feb.mean.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`Apr 2022 -> Source: ${apr.source}, Imgs: ${apr.imgs}, Valid px: ${apr.valid}/${apr.total}, SWE(mm): ${apr.mean !== undefined ? apr.mean.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);

    // 4. Error handling outcomes
    const statuses = [feb.status, apr.status];
    if (statuses.includes('C1')) { console.log('C1'); return; }
    if (statuses.includes('C2')) { console.log('C2'); return; }
    if (statuses.includes('C3')) { console.log('C3'); return; }

    // 5. Compare and answer
    const diff = feb.mean - apr.mean;
    console.log(`Diff (Feb - Apr) SWE (mm): ${diff.toFixed(1)}`);
    if (!isFinite(diff)) { console.log('C3'); return; }
    console.log(diff > 0 ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
